_about: Words the exhibit shows that belong to no one person: the attract screen's headline and tagline, and the About words (block about, a body of paragraphs separated by a blank line, approved for the display and the website). Each block reaches visitors only once a curator approves it for a target, with a decisionReference and the contentVersion the pipeline reports for exactly these words (npm run build:kiosk prints it). Change a word and the approval no longer matches, so the block is held back until it is approved again. Until then the attract screen shows the hall's name alone.

attract.headline: The world, at home in Cleveland.
attract.tagline: Meet the people who made it so, recognised by their communities, for their communities.
attract.source: Design handoff 'Wall & Poster', September 2026; default wording, awaiting editorial sign-off.

review.note: Reviewed by Tony Yanick in the staff review app.

about.body:
Since 2010, the Cleveland International Hall of Fame has inducted people who have made significant and lasting contributions to our multicultural society.

Cleveland is home to people representing about 120 different ethnic groups.

The Hall of Fame exists not only to honor those special people, but also to inspire a new generation of leaders to follow in their footsteps.
about.source: The Hall's own page, https://www.clevelandpeople.com/hof/hof.htm; wording copied from it.

review.note: Approved by Tony Yanick, who asked for it in a Claude Code session; wording is the Hall's own, from clevelandpeople.com/hof.
